name: The Shape of AI
summary: Pattern library for AI UX with 60 patterns in six groups — Wayfinders, Inputs, Tuners, Governors, Trust builders, Identifiers.
description: A reference project on how UX evolves with AI. Each pattern — Initial CTA, follow-up, nudges, randomize, madlibs, open input, regenerate, restyle, summary, synthesis, citations, verification, name, personality and more — comes with a description, design considerations, related patterns and examples from real mobile and web apps. Patterns are grouped into six types: Wayfinders, Inputs, Tuners, Governors, Trust builders and Identifiers. A UI library with hundreds of real-world AiUX examples, deep dives and courses is announced as coming soon; the newsletter is free.
